nodes.long_description:
Unleash the Power of the Jelly!

Welcome to Match & Merge: VR Jelly World, an addictive puzzle experience designed specifically for VR. Set within a mysterious medieval room—complete with torches, cobwebs, and castle walls—you’ll solve logic-based challenges from a unique tabletop perspective.

Your mission is simple but satisfying: move the jelly pieces across the board to fill the empty shapes. But be careful—each move counts as you navigate increasingly complex patterns and vibrant color combinations.

Game Features:
Interactive Joystick Gameplay: Use your controllers to precisely slide and snap jelly pieces into place.

Tabletop Diorama Style: Experience the game from a comfortable diorama view, making it feel like you’re playing with a living board game on your desk.

Medieval Atmosphere: Solve puzzles in a beautifully rendered dungeon setting featuring atmospheric lighting and immersive sound effects.

Evolving Logic Puzzles: Progress through numerous levels that test your spatial awareness and color-matching skills.

Squishy, Satisfying Visuals: Watch as the colorful jellies merge and fill the voids with high-definition, immersive effects.

Get ready to dive into the most satisfying VR puzzle game of the year. Grab your headset and start merging today!
nodes.short_description: Step into a squishy world of color and logic! In Match & Merge: VR Jelly World, use your joystick to guide vibrant jelly pieces through a medieval-style dungeon. Strategically match shapes and colors to fill the patterns and clear each level. With its charming diorama view and immersive puzzles, can you master the art of the jelly merge?

nodes.long_description: Giải phóng sức mạnh của Jelly! Đặc điểm: Lối chơi joystick tương tác, phong cách sa bàn (diorama) và không khí trung cổ sống động.
nodes.short_description: Bước vào thế giới màu sắc và logic! Sử dụng joystick để dẫn dắt những viên thạch rực rỡ qua ngục tối thời trung cổ trong VR.
